Weakness Name: Ensure a host firewall is active
Weakness Description: Found: iptables has no rules and accepts by default. Expected: ufw, firewalld, nftables or iptables is active with a filtering rule set.
Overall Remediation Plan: Enable one host firewall, for example "ufw enable" after allowing the services the host needs.

Weakness Name: Ensure mounting of squashfs filesystems is disabled
Weakness Description: Found: squashfs is available in the running kernel (listed in /proc/filesystems). Expected: The squashfs kernel module is not loaded and cannot be loaded.
Overall Remediation Plan: Create /etc/modprobe.d/squashfs.conf containing "install squashfs /bin/false" and "blacklist squashfs". Do not apply this on hosts that use snap packages.

Weakness Name: Ensure packet redirect sending is disabled
Weakness Description: Found: net.ipv4.conf.all.send_redirects = 1, net.ipv4.conf.default.send_redirects = 1. Expected: net.ipv4.conf.all.send_redirects and net.ipv4.conf.default.send_redirects are 0.
Overall Remediation Plan: Set both send_redirects keys to 0 in a file under /etc/sysctl.d and run "sysctl --system".

Weakness Name: Ensure source routed packets are not accepted
Weakness Description: Found: net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route = 0, net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route = 1; IPv6 is not enabled. Expected: accept_source_route is 0 for "all" and "default" on IPv4 and on IPv6 where IPv6 is enabled.
Overall Remediation Plan: Set the accept_source_route keys to 0 in a file under /etc/sysctl.d and run "sysctl --system".

Weakness Name: Ensure ICMP redirects are not accepted
Weakness Description: Found: net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects = 1, net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_redirects = 1; IPv6 is not enabled. Expected: accept_redirects is 0 for "all" and "default" on IPv4 and on IPv6 where IPv6 is enabled.
Overall Remediation Plan: Set the accept_redirects keys to 0 in a file under /etc/sysctl.d and run "sysctl --system".
